trap.label: despite + oração
trap.wrong: Despite she had no training, she led the delegation.
trap.right: Although she had no training, she led the delegation.
trap.why: Em português “apesar de ela não ter” aceita infinitivo flexionado; o aluno usa despite + sujeito + verbo. Em inglês, despite exige substantivo ou -ing.

fix.wrong: Despite she had no training, she led.
fix.right: Despite having no training, she led.

fix.wrong: Young she was, she led the delegation.
fix.right: Young as she was, she led the delegation.

fix.wrong: Though of her patience, she lost.
fix.right: Though she was patient, she lost.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Despite + -ing: “Although she had no training, she led.”
rewrite.answer: Despite having no training, she led.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Adj + as: “Although she was young, she led.”
rewrite.answer: Young as she was, she led.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Much as: “Although they doubted her, she won.”
rewrite.answer: Much as they doubted her, she won.
